scope: Owned native selection access under immutable application identities
invariant: Owned selections deny access across full workspace and application identities, except for supervisor and compositor connections.
required_evidence: The new counterexample suite fails on the rebuilt pre-patch baseline and passes with the patched policy; policy source hashes match both builds.
Foreign queries, replacement, clearing, and conversion rejected
Same-application conversion emits a real SelectionRequest
Workspace membership and matching application names across workspaces grant no access
Supervisor and compositor positive controls; broker denial
Both native byte orders and independently owned PRIMARY and SECONDARY selections
Debug and ASan/UBSan native server checks on both authorized hosts
Locked P00-P10 tests remain unchanged and pass against the patched server.
limitations: This component checks owned selections; it does not complete selection privacy or M04.
Atom-name privacy, independent application selection namespaces, and asynchronous metadata remain unqualified.
Focused core-X sanitizer runs disable GLX and do not qualify graphics-provider cleanup.
